Name: Anime Portraits - Looking for Love Support
Author: coldazrael
Description:
[b]Want more portraits by OhoDavi?
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Click Here[/url]﻿[/size][/b]

The current available portraits right now is Sandy and Pam at the moment, more portraits will be added soon.
If you see pam blushing out of place during penny's 6 heart event, it's a bug from Looking for Love itself and the author stated it will be fixed in next update.

[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and install the required mods (Content Patcher, Looking for Love)
[*]Download this mod
[*]Drop/Extract the folder inside the .zip to /Stardew Valley/Mods folder
[/list]
[b]Config Options :[/b]
[list]
[*][i]EnableMod[/i]
Master config to turn on and turn off the mod, the values are "true" or "false". The default is "true".[*][i]Sandy[/i]
Config that changes Sandy's portrait, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled", set to "disabled" if you don't want to change Sandy's portrait.[*][i]Pam[/i]
Config that changes Pam's portrait, the values are "enabled" or "disabled". The default is "enabled", set to "disabled" if you don't want to change Pam's portrait.[/list]
